caption: The drawing depicts a wooden cabinet with two main doors and angled side panels, each featuring ornate decorative carvings. The cabinet has a rectangular shape with a projecting cornice on top and stands on four round, dark-colored bun feet. The front and visible side panels are intricately adorned with symmetrical, high-relief carvings of fruits, foliage, and ribbons. On each main door, there is a large, central composition featuring a bow at the top, from which hangs an arrangement of fruit including pears, pomegranates, grapes, and various round fruits, with leaves and small branches extending outward. Flanking the central fruit arrangements are vertical garlands of leaves and fruit, and a bird perched among the foliage is visible on each door. The color palette consists of muted browns, greens, golds, and grays, suggesting the use of watercolor or ink, with a softly shaded background emphasizing the carved designs. The artist's signature, "Lily H. Copson," appears at the lower left of the cabinet. The background of the drawing is plain and unadorned.
title: Kas
